result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would recommend **Dropbox Sign or SignWell**\. They offer a good balance of affordability, ease of use, and professional-looking signature workflows without the complexity of enterprise software.

However, the best choice depends on how often you send contracts and what types of documents you need signed.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses (2026)

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign** (Best overall for simplicity)

## \$15/mo

- Easy to send contracts and collect signatures.
- Reusable templates and signing reminders.
- Good Dropbox integration.
- Great for client agreements, NDAs, and service contracts.

Best for small businesses wanting straightforward e-signatures.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. SignWell**

(Best value)

## \$10/mo

- Simple, clean interface.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signing notifications and audit trails.
- Free plan available (3 documents/month).

Best for solo owners and small teams watching expenses.

[Visit SignWell](https://signwell.com/)

---

![Account: Docusign Inc](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dVhOhGt1QpkndwtGW47-sHNKllomPpU4vxs24pNswQkR4ZS5Rob9EH7Az_JSTVPfQ9TrCcH0e5oK9YdRNpm6RmBNsVkzxCsRHsY0XVby2paTjfNsyLWxXQIwIgoVkcHAN04Sy6nvt4MWYDJyoVDMUxLCH1igYXq2J2nv9XGNpFZ1f102xwVUVNokEDaHEjlQ?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

## \$11/mo

- Widely recognized by clients.
- Extensive integrations.
- Advanced signing workflows.
- Good tracking and document management.

Best for businesses handling important contracts and working with larger organizations.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

## \$19/user/mo

- Creates professional proposals and quotes.
- Document templates and content libraries.
- E-signatures and sales workflows.
- Integrates with CRM platforms.

Best for businesses sending proposals, estimates, and contracts to customers.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. signNow**

## \$8/user/mo

- Affordable signing workflows.
- Document templates.
- Multiple signer support.
- Team collaboration features.

Best for budget-conscious businesses with multiple employees.

[Visit signNow](https://www.signnow.com/)

Pricing is indicative starting pricing in USD; annual billing, user limits, and document allowances vary. Verify current plan terms before subscribing. Sources: [dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-esignature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your business needs | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and signatures | Dropbox Sign |
| Lowest-cost, simple solution | SignWell |
| Professional, widely recognized platform | DocuSign |
| Proposals, quotes, and contracts | PandaDoc |
| Multiple employees on a budget | signNow |


## What I'd look for before buying

Regardless of which platform you choose, make sure it includes\:

- Legally valid electronic signatures (ESIGN Act and UETA in the US).
- Audit trails showing who signed and when.
- Automatic reminders for unsigned documents.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Secure document storage.
- Multiple signers and signing order.
- Downloadable, completed PDF copies.
